room.name: The Bell’s Teeth
room.hint: Launch with momentum. Spend every cracked landing on the next transfer. Bounce clear of the thorned needles, and change dash angle at the suspended crystals.

bank.csideDescription: Long momentum transfers climb two thorned needles, then drop into an unsupported refill undercut. Three narrow takeoff perches; one fire.
